They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone…

translations.web: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
translations.bsb: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
translations.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
translations.asv: and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.
